English(en): It has become fashionable amongst the people to strive to live simpler lives.
Unusually rich currents bring fish closer to shore.
Peoples lives are becoming easy. Maybe a little too easy. Nobody wants to work hard anymore.
The rich elite is becoming unusually crafty. Perhaps a new trend to pass the time.
Bad weather ruins much of the seasonal crops.
The nobility around these parts are in a giving mood and support all towns in their development.
The clouds are dark, the air is thick. This storm isn't going to end any time soon.
People need to ride and they take what they can get.
Large parts of the mountains have become impassable making the mines hardly usable.
A regional fair attracts traders and travelers.
Rumors of a coming plague are spreading. Panic sets in, and the people know their priorities: anything remotely suitable for wiping their behinds.
